_about: Egypt market model inputs. Sector rows transcribed from docs/market/gemini-research-2026-08.md (all counts are Gemini estimates, flag 'est'). Assumptions are ours and deliberately adjustable.

assumptions._basis: Fees from the published offer (self-service model). Effort from the pricing build: ~3.7 days per 26-60 asset client.
assumptions._avg_year1_fee_note: 48,000 baseline (26-60 tier) + typical add-ons (guided sessions, measurement design share)

flags: Cross-cutting total (4,885 manufacturers with 10+ employees) contradicts the per-sector totals (food_processing alone claims 7,000). The bulletin figure is a narrow formal-sector sample; per-sector counts include informal/unregistered firms. Do not quote the two side by side.
All energy prices in the research are 2024 vintage; it is 2026-08. Diesel/tariffs have moved since. Refresh before quoting to a client.
Every establishment count is EST with stated-but-unverified reasoning. Treat as directional ranking input, not as a figure to publish.
ESCO audit benchmark EGP 50,000-150,000 [UNIDO 2023] - our 38,000-69,000 self-service pricing undercuts the low end with no site visit cost.
